hardware_gate_sets.notes: Device-specific instructions vary. Modern ECR/CZ targets with Rz/SX/X; CX retained as an abstract and historical target.
PhasedXZ local gates; fixed SYC is distinct from freely parameterized fSim. Device availability is not implied by a mathematical preset.
GPi/GPi2 and MS on Aria, ZZ on Forte. Native turns and interaction bounds are explicit in gate metadata; mathematical matrices also exist outside hardware ranges.
PhasedX/Rz with ZZMax or ZZPhase; TK2 is an SU4 compiler macro. Rz catalog arguments are radians; PhasedX/ZZPhase/TK2 use TKET half turns.
Rz and fixed Rx(k*pi/2), CZ; SX preset representation requires a separately tracked phase relative to physical Rx(pi/2).
R, Rz, Rxx targets in provider radians.
PRX and CZ represented mathematically by R and CZ; convert provider units at the API boundary. Resonator MOVE is not counted as a qubit entangler.
Dense universality does not imply exact finite synthesis for arbitrary real symbolic angles.
